game.title.description: Name of the Hearts card game.
game.title.notes: Use the locale's standard name for the Hearts card game.

game.description.description: One-line description on the Hearts game card.

game.playLabel.description: Accessibility label for the Hearts play button.

card.faceDown.description: Screen-reader label for a face-down card.

card.label.description: Screen-reader label for a visible card, e.g. 'Queen of Spades'.
card.label.notes: Word order may differ by locale (e.g. Japanese uses suit first).

card.highlighted.description: Screen-reader label for a card that is a valid play.

hand.player.description: Screen-reader label for the human player's hand.

hand.opponent.description: Screen-reader label for an AI opponent's hand.

captured.taken.description: Label above the row showing penalty cards the human has taken this hand. Styled uppercase.
captured.taken.notes: Rendered as uppercase tracking label. If the locale doesn't support uppercase styling, a short all-caps equivalent is fine.

captured.empty.description: Italic placeholder shown in the 'Taken' row when the human has not yet captured any penalty cards this hand.

captured.opponentLabel.description: Screen-reader label describing how many penalty cards and points an AI opponent has captured this hand.

captured.selfLabel.description: Screen-reader label describing how many penalty cards and points the human has captured this hand.

trick.area.description: Accessibility label for the trick-play area.

trick.slot.empty.description: Accessibility label for an empty trick slot for a player.

trick.winner.description: Announced when a player wins the trick.

score.board.description: Label for the scores panel / scoreboard.

score.player.description: Column header for the player name column.

score.round.description: Abbreviated header for the round-number column in the Hearts scoreboard's score history table.

score.total.description: Column header for the cumulative score column.

score.hand.description: Column header for the per-hand score column.

score.footnote.description: Footnote under the score history table explaining the shoot-the-moon rule.
score.footnote.notes: Keep the ★ symbol and the number (26).

pass.direction.left.description: Direction label when passing cards to the left.

pass.direction.right.description: Direction label when passing cards to the right.

pass.direction.across.description: Direction label when passing cards across.

pass.direction.none.description: Shown on the round when no cards are passed.

pass.instructions.description: Instruction telling the player to choose 3 cards to pass in a given direction.
pass.instructions.notes: {{direction}} is replaced by one of pass.direction.* values.

pass.selected.description: Shows how many cards are currently selected out of 3.

pass.confirm.description: Short label on the confirm/pass button.

pass.confirmLabel.description: Full accessibility label for the confirm button including selected count.

player.you.description: Label for the human player (bottom seat).

player.left.description: Label for the left AI opponent.

player.top.description: Label for the top AI opponent.

player.right.description: Label for the right AI opponent.

hand_end.title.description: Title shown at the end of each hand.

hand_end.moon.description: Message shown when a player shoots the moon (takes all hearts + Queen of Spades).
hand_end.moon.notes: 'Shooting the moon' is a Hearts strategy term — adapt to what gamers in the locale would recognize.

hand_end.next.description: Button to advance to the next hand.

score.close.description: Accessibility label for the close button on the score panel.

settings.rename.description: Short label for the control that opens the rename-players modal.

settings.rename_title.description: Title of the modal for editing the four seats' player names.

settings.player_label.description: Label and accessibility label for one seat's name input in the rename modal.
settings.player_label.notes: {{n}} is the seat number 1-4; {{default}} is that seat's default name (e.g. "You" or "West").

settings.save.description: Save button in the rename-players modal.

settings.cancel.description: Cancel button in the rename-players modal.

events.heartsBroken.description: Accessibility label for the animation announcing that Hearts have been broken (a Heart has been played and can now lead a trick).

events.moonShot.description: Text and accessibility label for the celebration animation when a player shoots the moon.
events.moonShot.notes: {{name}} is the shooting player's display name.

events.queenOfSpades.description: Accessibility label for the animation when a player takes the Queen of Spades.
events.queenOfSpades.notes: {{name}} is the taking player's display name.

difficulty.groupLabel.description: Accessibility group label for the AI opponent-style radio group.

difficulty.cautious.description: Label for the 'Cautious' AI opponent-style option.

difficulty.cautious.desc.description: One-line description of the 'Cautious' AI opponent style.

difficulty.schemer.description: Label for the 'Schemer' AI opponent-style option.

difficulty.schemer.desc.description: One-line description of the 'Schemer' AI opponent style.

difficulty.daring.description: Label for the 'Daring' AI opponent-style option.

difficulty.daring.desc.description: One-line description of the 'Daring' AI opponent style.

difficulty.mixed.description: Label for the 'Mixed Table' option (one of each AI opponent style).

difficulty.mixed.desc.description: One-line description of the 'Mixed Table' option, naming the seating of the three AI styles.
difficulty.mixed.desc.notes: References the three persona names (Cautious, Schemer, Daring) — keep them consistent with difficulty.cautious/schemer/daring.

game.startGame.description: Button (and its accessibility label) to start a new Hearts game from the pre-game opponent-style picker.
